# Vendored GitLab documentation

Verbatim copies of GitLab's own documentation source (Markdown, `doc/` of
https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab, branch `master`, GitLab version 19.7.0-pre), fetched
2026-11-23. File names flatten the `doc/` path: `api_merge_requests.md` is
`doc/api/merge_requests.md`. They are the reference the GitLab code and its tests cite;
refresh them with the pin in [UPSTREAM.md](../../../UPSTREAM.md). Copyright GitLab Inc.,
MIT-licensed documentation source; kept unmodified.
